title: MCP Amaseva
allowPermissionsDesc: Uma kuvuliwe, zonke izingcingo zezixhobo MCP zizovunyelwa ngokuzenzakalayo ngaphandle kokukhombisa izingxoxo zemvume. Lolu hlelo lusebenza kuwo wonke amazwi, kuhlanganise nezincwadi ezintsha.

runtimeSettings.title: Izilungiselelo Zokusebenza
runtimeSettings.description: Lungisa ukuthi Novera ilawula kanjani futhi izame futhi iziphakeli MCP.
runtimeSettings.toolCallTimeoutDesc: Isikhathi esikhulu sokulinda impendulo yethuluzi MCP ngaphambi kokuphelelwa isikhathi.
runtimeSettings.maxToolOutputCharsDesc: Umphumela wethuluzi omude kakhulu ogcinwa engxoxweni. Noma yini edlula lokhu iyasuswa futhi iboniswe njengefushane, ukuze umphumela omkhulu ungadogi umfutho womongo womodeli. Setha ku-0 ukuze ugcine imiphumela yonke.
runtimeSettings.smartToolRoutingDesc: Uma kuvuliwe, Novera ikhetha iziphakeli MCP ezifanele ngaphambi kokulayisha amathuluzi. Vala ukuze ulayishe njalo uhlu lwamathuluzi MCP ngokuphelele.
runtimeSettings.useLightweightRouterModelDesc: Lapho ukuhlela okuhlakaniphile kuvaliwe, sebenzisa isinyathelo sokuhlela ngomodeli ohlukile (ngokuvamile omncane) esikhundleni somodeli wengxoxo. Vala ukuze uhlale usebenzisa imodeli yengxoxo esebenzayo ekubhekaneni.
runtimeSettings.routerModelDesc: Khetha umhlinzeki nemodeli endaweni eyodwa. Kuphelele imodeli ezelula ukuze ukuhlela kuhlale kushesha futhi kubize kancane.
runtimeSettings.routerModelEmptyList: Ayikho imodeli ezelula etholakalayo. Faka imodeli encane noma hlela okhiye API ku-Models.
